enabled.description: Enable or disable the deluged daemon.

log_file.description: Path to log file. Empty means log to stdout only if console logging enabled.

listen_interface.description: Network interface/IP for JSON-RPC/WebUI API listening. Use 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces.

json_rpc_port.description: Port for the JSON-RPC API used by deluge-web and external clients.

json_rpc_ssl_enabled.description: Enable SSL/TLS for the JSON-RPC interface. Required for secure web UI access.

ssl_certificate_path.description: Path to SSL certificate file (PEM format) for JSON-RPC HTTPS.

ssl_private_key_path.description: Path to SSL private key file (PEM format) for JSON-RPC HTTPS.

auth_enabled.description: Enable password authentication for the daemon.

default_username.description: Default admin username (created on first start if auth enabled and no auth file exists).

default_password.description: Default password (insecure; will be hashed on first run if auth enabled).

allow_remote.description: Allow connections from remote hosts. If false, only localhost (127.0.0.1) is permitted.

allowed_hosts.description: List of IP addresses or hostnames allowed to connect via JSON-RPC/WebUI. Ignored if allow_remote=false.

worker_threads.description: Number of threads used for I/O operations (disk, network).

enable_resume_data_cache.description: Cache resume data to disk for faster restarts.

max_connections_per_torrent.description: Maximum number of peer connections per torrent.

max_uploads_per_torrent.description: Maximum number of upload slots per torrent.

upload_rate_limit.description: Global upload rate limit in KiB/s. 0 means unlimited.

download_rate_limit.description: Global download rate limit in KiB/s. 0 means unlimited.

enable_dht.description: Enable Distributed Hash Table (DHT) for peer discovery.

enable_lsd.description: Enable Local Service Discovery (LSD) for local network peer discovery.

enable_upnp.description: Enable automatic port forwarding via UPnP.

enable_natpmp.description: Enable automatic port forwarding via NAT-PMP.

listen_ports.description: List of ports for incoming BitTorrent peer connections. First is TCP, second (optional) is UDP. Often only TCP is used.

randomize_ports.description: If true, choose random ports from listen_ports range on each start (helpful for multi-instance setups).
